story_overview: A brilliant detective, Arthur Vance, is called to solve the murder of a wealthy clockmaker, Alistair Sterling, inside his locked workshop. The main clue is a broken pocket watch found in the victim's hand. The suspect is Alistair's estranged apprentice, Julian, who claims he was miles away, but Arthur suspects Julian used a clockwork automaton to fake his alibi.

global_plan.title: The Clockwork Alibi
global_plan.synopsis: A locked-room mystery where a brilliant detective uses physical evidence and mechanical reconstruction to break a perfect clockwork alibi.
global_plan.theme: The precision of truth vs. the illusion of perfection
narrative_arc: Setup: Arthur Vance arrives at the locked workshop and discovers the victim and the broken pocket watch.
Rising Action: Arthur interrogates Julian, who presents a seemingly airtight alibi verified by a distant town clock.
Climax: Arthur discovers and activates the clockwork automaton, demonstrating how it mechanically triggered the crime and the pocket watch at a distance.
Resolution: Julian confesses as his alibi is shattered by the laws of mechanics.
constraints: Maintain consistent Victorian-steampunk aesthetic across all shots.
Arthur Vance must wear his signature tweed coat and carry a brass magnifying glass.
The workshop must be filled with ticking clocks, gears, and warm, dusty shafts of light.
The pocket watch (E4) must have its glass cracked with hands frozen at exactly 10:15.

creative_intent.theme: The precision of truth vs. the illusion of perfection
creative_intent.visual_style: Warm dusty Victorian interiors, brass clockwork machinery, low-key mystery lighting

cast_and_assets.name: Arthur Vance
cast_and_assets.creative_description: A calm, sharp-eyed detective whose careful observation and restraint contrast with the workshop's mechanical chaos.
state_notes: Keeps his brown tweed coat and brass magnifying glass throughout the story.

cast_and_assets.name: Julian Sterling
cast_and_assets.creative_description: A young apprentice trying to preserve a false alibi while panic slowly breaks through his composure.
state_notes: Begins defensive and anxious, then visibly collapses after the reconstruction.

cast_and_assets.name: Clockwork Automaton
cast_and_assets.creative_description: A life-sized brass machine that appears decorative until Arthur reveals it as the physical mechanism behind the murder.
state_notes: Starts dormant in the corner, then transforms into an active moving mechanism.

cast_and_assets.name: Broken Pocket Watch
cast_and_assets.creative_description: The victim's ornate silver pocket watch, cracked and frozen at 10:15, anchoring the mystery's timeline.
state_notes: Must remain cracked with hands frozen at exactly 10:15 whenever visible.

cast_and_assets.name: The Clock Workshop
cast_and_assets.creative_description: A dusty Victorian workshop packed with clocks, gears, workbenches, tools, and golden shafts of light.
state_notes: Functions as both the crime scene and the stage for the mechanical reconstruction.

scenes.scene_purpose: Introduce the locked-room crime scene and the physical clue that anchors the mystery.

beats.action: Arthur Vance eases open the heavy workshop door and steps into a room of dust, brass gears, and restless ticking.
Near the workbench, Arthur kneels and lifts the broken pocket watch into a shaft of golden light, studying the cracked glass and frozen hands.

scenes.scene_purpose: Confront Julian with the clue and establish his apparently airtight alibi.

beats.action: Julian sits rigidly on a wooden stool under the lamp while Arthur stands opposite him with the pocket watch in hand.

dialogue.line: I was at the tavern across town, sir! The church clock struck ten when I arrived.

scenes.scene_purpose: Shift the investigation from testimony to mechanism.

beats.action: Arthur leaves Julian behind and studies the brass automaton in the corner, letting his magnifying glass catch the glint of exposed gears.
Arthur traces a thin copper wire from the automaton along the wall, then turns back with the first trace of a smile.

dialogue.line: A perfect alibi, Julian. Except that machines, unlike men, leave a precise trail.

scenes.scene_purpose: Reconstruct the mechanism of the crime and break Julian's alibi.

beats.action: Arthur winds the automaton with a brass key; gears begin to spin, and Julian rises from his stool with horror spreading across his face.
The automaton strikes a lever, the copper wire pulls, and a pulley-weight system smashes a replica watch as Julian collapses under the proof.

dialogue.line: Stop... please, stop! I didn't mean to kill him... it was supposed to be an accident!
